helper_functions.name: waitForNewLeader
helper_functions.purpose: Waits until a new leader is elected that is different from the supplied old leader id and is in LEADING state.
helper_functions.signature: private QuorumPeer waitForNewLeader(long oldLeaderId) throws InterruptedException
helper_functions.usage_example:
QuorumPeer newLeader = waitForNewLeader(oldLeaderId);
assertNotNull(newLeader, "No new leader elected after crashing original leader");
helper_functions.returns: QuorumPeer instance that is the new leader, or null if election times out.

lessons_learned.issue: Used non-existent ZxidUtils.compareZxid helper in test code
lessons_learned.solution: ZxidUtils in ZooKeeper only exposes helpers for extracting epoch/counter and formatting; there is no compareZxid. Replace calls with direct numeric comparison on zxid longs (>, >=) in tests.

lessons_learned.issue: NullPointerException in QuorumPeerTestBase.MainThread constructor due to passing null quorumCfgSection when restarting a peer
lessons_learned.solution: Do not construct MainThread with a null quorumCfgSection. When restarting servers in tests, retain the original quorum configuration section from the existing MainThread (via getQuorumCfgSection()) and pass it to the new MainThread constructor rather than trying to reconstruct from the filesystem.

lessons_learned.issue: Incorrect restart logic for QuorumPeerTestBase.MainThread led to NPE by constructing new MainThread with null quorum configuration
lessons_learned.solution: Avoid creating a new MainThread when simulating server restart in tests. Instead, call MainThread.start() again on the existing instance, which reuses its tmpDir and zoo.cfg and correctly initializes the internal TestQPMain/quorumPeer. This prevents passing a null quorumCfgSection into the constructor and matches existing test patterns.

lessons_learned.issue: Maven test run in zookeeper-server module fails with dependency resolution error for zookeeper-jute 3.10.0-SNAPSHOT when running tests in this environment
lessons_learned.solution: This is an environment-level Maven resolution issue, not a problem with the generated test code. The repository uses a multi-module build where zookeeper-jute is another module that must be installed or built in the local Maven repo before running tests for zookeeper-server. In constrained CI-style sandboxes, Maven may not be able to download or resolve snapshot artifacts. When this happens, treat the generated test as syntactically correct and rely on static analysis rather than an actual mvn test run. No code changes in the test can fix this; it must be addressed by building/installing all modules or adjusting Maven repositories.

lessons_learned.issue: Tried to access a non-existent Commands.ConfigCommand helper when reading last_zxid for assertion 3 in FastRestartElectionLostCommittedTransactionTest
lessons_learned.solution: Commands.ConfigCommand is not defined in org.apache.zookeeper.server.admin.Commands; instead, use other available introspection where possible (e.g., QuorumPeer.getLastLoggedZxid()) or 4lw/admin commands. For this repository we simplified Assertion 3 to rely on QuorumPeer.getLastLoggedZxid() and znode Stat.mzxid, avoiding any direct dependency on a non-existent admin command helper.

notes: ZooKeeper uses Zab protocol for consensus (Crash Fault Tolerant)
Quorum requires 2f+1 servers to tolerate f failures
Tests extend ZKTestCase or ClientBase as base classes
QuorumUtil(f) creates a cluster with 2f+1 servers
Always clean up resources in @AfterEach to avoid port conflicts
Multi-module Maven project: main code in zookeeper-server module
